meaning: 天地宇宙，初开时混沌荒远。
en: The universe was vast and wild at the beginning.
Sun and moon fill, wane and decline.
Stars spread out and fill the sky.
Cold and heat follow one another.
Harvest in autumn, store in winter.

meaning: 以闰月补足余日，凑成一年。
en: Leap months complete the year.
Pitch pipes harmonize the yang.
Clouds rise and become rain.
Dew freezes into white frost.
Gold comes from the Li waters.
Jade comes from Kunlun's slopes.

meaning: 宝剑中最著名的是巨阙。
en: The sword Juque is the most famous of blades.

meaning: 宝珠之中，夜光最受称道。
en: Among pearls, Night Glow is the famed one.

meaning: 果品珍贵的是李子和柰。
en: Plums and crabapples are the prized fruits.

meaning: 蔬菜看重的是芥菜和姜。
en: Mustard greens and ginger matter among vegetables.
The sea is salty, the river fresh.

meaning: 有鳞的潜水，有羽的飞翔。
en: Scaled fish dive, feathered birds fly.

meaning: 伏羲以龙名官，神农以火纪官。
en: Fuxi named offices by dragons, Shennong by fire.

meaning: 少昊以鸟名官，人皇治理天下。
en: Shaohao named offices by birds; the Human Sovereign ruled.
Writing was first created.
Then came upper and lower garments.
Thrones were yielded and realms ceded.

meaning: 有虞氏的舜，陶唐氏的尧。
en: Shun of Youyu and Yao of Taotang.

meaning: 安抚百姓，讨伐有罪之人。
en: Comfort the people, punish the guilty.
King Wu of Zhou and Tang of Shang.
Hold court and ask after the way.

meaning: 垂衣拱手，天下太平章明。
en: Rule at ease; all is ordered and bright.
Cherish and raise the common people.
Make the Rong and Qiang submit.
Far and near become one body.
Lead all to pledge to the king.
The phoenix calls in the tree.
A white colt grazes in the yard.
Virtue reaches even plants.
Its blessing reaches every direction.
This body and hair of ours.

meaning: 四大与五常：地水火风，仁义礼智信。
en: The four elements and the five constants.
Rear them with reverence.
How dare we harm them.
Women admire purity.
Men emulate talent and goodness.
Know a fault and mend it.
Do not forget what you have gained.
Do not speak of others' faults.
Do not lean on your own strengths.

meaning: 言语诚信，才可反复查验。
en: Trustworthiness can bear checking.
Capacity should be hard to fathom.
Mozi grieved that plain silk gets dyed.
The Odes praise the lamb.
Lofty conduct belongs to the worthy.
Restrain your thoughts and become a sage.

meaning: 德行建立，名声随之而立。
en: Virtue built, the name stands.
Upright in body and bearing.

meaning: 空谷之中，声音传得很远。
en: Sound carries in an empty valley.
In a bare hall one listens and learns.
Misfortune comes from piled-up evil.
Blessings follow good deeds.

meaning: 一尺大的玉璧，不算真正的宝。
en: A foot-wide jade is not the treasure.
Contend for every inch of time.
Serve your father, serve your lord.
It calls for gravity and respect.
Filial piety takes all your strength.
Loyalty gives up life itself.
As at a deep gulf, on thin ice.

meaning: 早起侍奉，冬日温暖，夏日清凉。
en: Rise early; warm them in winter, cool them in summer.
Fragrant as the orchid.
Flourishing as the pine.
Rivers flow without rest.

meaning: 深潭清澈，可以照见形影。
en: A clear pool mirrors your shape.

meaning: 仪容举止，沉静如有所思。
en: Composed as if pondering.
Words calm and steady.
Hold the beginning true; it is fair.
End carefully, and end well.
Here the work of glory is founded.
Fame grows beyond all end.
Excel in study, enter office.
Take a post and govern.

meaning: 留下甘棠之思，纪念德政。
en: Keep the sweet pear tree in memory.
Once gone, one is sung the more.
Music differs by rank.
Rites tell high from low.

meaning: 在上者和睦，在下者亲近。
en: High and low in harmony.
Husband leads, wife follows.
